verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Warp SSH integration that carries terminfo, shell integration, or config to remote hosts. The SSH mentions in the docs (warp-docs-59, warp-docs-79) describe running the `warp` agent CLI inside any terminal, which is a different capability. Community remarks about using SSH, including one user bypassing an SSH issue with 'command ssh', only hint that Warp wraps ssh and are not first-party documentation of the capability.
